status_summary: DOE's Arctic Energy Office, announced on 2020-09-17, remains listed on the DOE site under an acting director who is a Deputy Under Secretary of Energy. Its page lists 2025 and 2026 items such as a 2025-06-06 Alaska visit by cabinet officials and a 2026-06-23 Arctic Seeds grant announcement, but no expansion of Alaska operations, Antarctic lead role, Arctic Council seat or new statement of Arctic energy interests. Executive Order 14153 of 2025-01-20 prioritized Alaska LNG and other Alaska resource steps but assigns its energy directives to other departments and does not mention DOE.
title: Define Arctic energy interests, expand Alaska operations, lead Antarctic work
uncertainties: Absence of evidence from a limited search. The researcher ran three searches on energy.gov Arctic pages, govinfo.gov (Executive Order 14153) and Alaska LNG items; the reviewer re-read the energy.gov Arctic page. That page links an Arctic Energy Office strategic plan whose date and contents were not opened, so a statement of interests cannot be excluded. Alaska LNG export authorizations are DOE actions on LNG exports and are tracked under c12-04, not here.
